violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. Follow up in 10 days.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC at 43f. (Butter, cream, milk, cheese all 43f)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS called facility manager to report issue and maintenance is coming to fix it.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Sink Not Used for Handwashing
violations.observation: The compartment(s) of the manual warewashing sink was observed being used for handwashing activity.
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing sink may not be used for hand washing. CDI washed at hand sink.
